Context: 3. Stepping up

- Rule 7 (10).  
The anomaly of a Government servant promoted or appointed to a higher post on or after 1-1-2016 drawing lower pay than his junior promoted or appointed subsequently to another identical post, shall also stepped up equal to the pay of the junior with effect from the date of promotion or appointment of the junior. - OM, dated 26-10-2018.
